summary: Module 03 edited into one module. node tools/check.mjs --module 3 --lang en --words reports 0 errors and 3 warnings: the expected 'figures not drawn yet' and the two unbuilt widgets (convolution-explorer, receptive-field-builder). The BEL control character the writers reported in 21-labs-b.md was already gone, and the three session-ref warnings (#paper1, #paper2, #what_goes_wrong) are fixed in the plan JSON. Concept prose comes to 18,401 words against a plan target of 15,550 (s1 1099, s2 1385, s3 1401, s4 1115, s5 919, s6 1393, s7 1370, s8 1708, s9 1115, s10 1674, s11 1309, s12 1283, s13 1450, s14 1180). This is above BRIEF's 13,000-17,000 band. The count fell from 19,299 only because removed figure captions are no longer counted; no prose was shortened. 18 of the 38 figures are kept: fig-03-1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 13, 14, 15, 18, 20, 24, 27, 28, 30, 32, 33, 35 and 36, and every kept figure is referred to in the text. No lab code was changed, so no lab was re-run. Every lab number quoted outside the labs now matches the real lab outputs. The plan JSON is still valid, and only its display fields and activity refs were changed.
changes: Made the concept text, the What-goes-wrong list, the exercises and the quiz agree with the real lab outputs. Section 5's Lab 2 shift result is now about 66%, and the MLP falls from about 97% to 44%; the plan's 67%/42% came from planning runs. In Section 8, the plan's 'residual reaches about 0.07; plain 19 about 0.4 against 0.07' is replaced by Lab 3's numbers: plain 55 about 2.1, residual 55 about 0.3 at peak 0.05, 19 layers 0.4 against 0.04. Section 8 also adds that the 55-layer residual net reaches 0.04-0.08 at peak 0.03 or 0.02 over three seeds while the plain nets stay behind. This applies the Lab 1-3 writer's correction without changing lab code.

Section 10's Lab 4 transfer table now holds the real five-seed means: scratch 0.913/0.969, block 1 0.909/0.966, blocks 1-2 0.873/0.959, probe 0.662/0.762, probe then fine-tune 0.807/0.960, block 1 then fine-tune 0.902/0.981. The interpretation is rewritten from 'block 1 beats scratch by 2.3 points' to 'block 1 matches scratch, deeper copies are worse, the probe is 25 points down'. The normalisation mistake is now 0.71 to 0.21, chance, not 0.72 to 0.51, in Section 10 and in What goes wrong. fig-03-24's annotations are now 0.91, 0.91, 0.66 and 0.81.

Section 12's Lab 5 numbers are updated: Dice 0.965 (IoU 0.933) with skips, 0.952 (0.908) without, band accuracy 0.950 against 0.920. The quiz's U-Net explanation is updated the same way. Section 13's Lab 5 measurement paragraph now gives the real 160 of 161 isolated circles, area 0.999 (sd 0.029), pixel-edge perimeter 1.266 and iso-contour 1.033 (sd 0.017). The plan had 221 circles, 0.996/0.056 and 1.036/0.041.

Section 14's Lab 6 worked example now uses the real outputs. The shortcut model scores 1.00/0.75/0.72 and the clean model 0.98 clean and 0.96 random-marker. Grad-CAM corner shares are 27% against 10%, with the reason the clean model's share exceeds 3.5%; saliency shares are 9% against 6%. The CAM identity is 2e-10 and the randomisation correlation 0.18. The plan's numbers were 0.68/0.64, 0.998/0.988, 26%/4%, 9%/3%, 3e-10 and 0.10.

Applied the exercise writer's correction in Section 13: the +21% from marching cubes on the binary mask is now explained by every vertex sitting at an edge midpoint plus the 4:1 voxel shape. Refinement at the same shape does not remove it; isotropic voxels reduce it. The text no longer says 'the 2 um slices leave terraces'.

Exercise 8's prompt and solution now match Lab 4. Block 1 'did as well as training from scratch', not 'transferred well'. The solution's claim that scratch loses at 5 images per class is replaced by Lab 4's actual finding.

Section 10 now attributes its augmentation numbers (0.90 to 0.83; 0.36 to 0.66 and 0.76 to 0.90) to runs of Lab 2's Try-this items 2 and 3 made when the module was prepared, because those items are not executed. What goes wrong points to them the same way.

Figures: removed 20 blocks, leaving 18. Lab-plot repeats: fig-03-8 (Lab 3 ERF), 19 (Lab 3 curves; its caption was also wrong about a flat residual curve), 25 (an unexecuted Lab 2 extension), 31 (Lab 5), 37 (Lab 6) and 38 (Lab 2 filters). Table or worked-example repeats: fig-03-2, 11, 12, 17, 21, 22 and 29. Decorative or redundant: fig-03-4 (the widget covers it), 6, 10, 16 (timeline), 23 (gallery), 26 and 34 (pipeline). References to removed figures were rewritten: Section 8 now points to Lab 3's plot, Section 2 and Section 14 to Lab 2 step 7, and Section 3 to Lab 3 step 5.

Added in-text references to every kept figure: 3.1, 3.3, 3.5, 3.7, 3.9, 3.13, 3.14, 3.15, 3.18 (left and right), 3.20, 3.24, 3.27 (left), 3.28, 3.30, 3.32, 3.33, 3.35 and 3.36. fig-03-35's caption now says that its 50.2 contour is of the mask blurred by a 0.9-pixel Gaussian, as the worked example states.

One symbol per quantity. Lab 3 called the receptive-field jump $j$, which the plan forbids; it is now $\Delta$ as in Section 3 and Exercise 3, and the code variable `jump` is named. Lab 6's Grad-CAM notation ($A_{k,ij}$, $w_{ck}$, $A_k$, $b_c$) now follows Section 14 ($A^k_{ij}$, $w_k^c$, $A^k$, $b^c$). The summary's output-size formula now uses $H$, not $n$.

Lab 3's 'What you should see' no longer claims that the residual networks reach the same low loss at every depth. It gives about 0.04 at 7 and 19 layers, and says 55 layers needs peak 0.03 or 0.02. What goes wrong's batch-norm entry now cites Section 10, where the 16-example threshold is stated, as well as Section 13.

Quiz: removed the 13th question (voxel spacing), which was not in the plan and broke the 10-12 limit of SPEC and BRIEF. The quiz is now 12 questions, matching its own introduction. Summary: 13 bullets became 12 by merging the layer-cost and cheaper-convolutions bullets; all content is kept.

Voice: three question headings became statements ('ConvNeXt: separating the recipe from the architecture'; Lab 3 'Step 8: the stability of the deep residual network'; Lab 6 'Step 7: a randomisation test of the map'). Lab 3 step 6 no longer opens with a rhetorical question. Long lines touched by edits were reflowed. 21-labs-b.md was normalised from CRLF to LF like the other parts.

Plan JSON (plan/module_03.json), display fields only. The lead was rewritten as one sentence without 'you'. The outcomes lost their 'By the end you can' style, are one sentence each, and put their maths in $...$ (the output-size formula, $1 \times 1$, $D = 2J/(1 + J)$). Prerequisites and software are one sentence each, with code names in backticks. Every activity 'what' is now one sentence that names Sections and Exercises in full. Refs paper1/paper2 now point to reading, what_goes_wrong to wrong, and the review activity to summary, wrong and terms. Session totals are 128, 115, 126, 119 and 128, 616 minutes in all. The JSON is still valid; a backup is at <local scratch folder>
